KNOWLEDGE_BASE.QA_DOCX_GUIDE_INTRO: Please confirm your file follows this structure before upload:
KNOWLEDGE_BASE.QA_DOCX_GUIDE_RULE_1: Each Q&A block must start with `Question:` then `Answer:`, and blocks are separated by `{separator}` on its own line.
KNOWLEDGE_BASE.QA_DOCX_GUIDE_RULE_2: DOCX embedded images are supported and will be extracted automatically.
KNOWLEDGE_BASE.QA_DOCX_GUIDE_RULE_3: Question and Answer can be multi-line rich text.
KNOWLEDGE_BASE.QA_DOCX_GUIDE_RULE_4: If a question already exists, we will update its answer. New questions will be added.
KNOWLEDGE_BASE.QA_DOCX_GUIDE_EXAMPLE:
Question: How do I reset my password?
Answer: Open Settings > Security and click "Reset Password".
------
Question: Can I include screenshots?
Answer: Yes, insert images directly inside the DOCX.
